about:
S.B. International, Inc. (SBI) was founded in 1982 in Nashville, Tennessee. The company began as a supplier of valvetrain components for automotive and heavy-duty engine markets, establishing a focus on product quality and availability.

SBI manufactures and supplies a comprehensive range of valvetrain components, including valve seat inserts, valves, valve keepers, valve stem seals, valve guides, valve springs, injector tubes, lifters, rocker arm components, pushrods, head saver shims, valve spring retainers and rotators, head bolts, and K-Line bronze valve guide liners. The company also offers Precision Engine Parts (PEP) product lines for domestic and diesel performance applications, supported by a technical service team and an online e-catalog.

The company serves the automotive, light and medium-duty truck, small to heavy-duty diesel truck and equipment, agricultural tractor, marine, and industrial engine markets worldwide. Its customers include engine parts distributors, production rebuilders, and specialty engine builders.

SBI emphasizes customer and technical service as key differentiators, offering worldwide distribution and up-to-date product availability. The company expanded its portfolio through acquisitions, including Ertel in 2001 and a partnership with K-Line Industries in 2008.
